article.title: Service of summons by post. Rep. by the Code of Civil Procedure (Amendment) Act, 1976
article.content:
20AService of summons by post. Rep. by the Code of Civil Procedure (Amendment) Act, 1976

Order 5, Rule 20A
1[Service of summons by post.] Rep. by the Code of Civil Procedure (Amendment) Act, 1976 (104 of 1976), s. 55 (w.e.f. 1-2-1977)].

1 Ins. by Act 66 of 1956, s. 14 (w.e.f. 1-1-1957).
